add-column: The three nullable, default-free history and owner columns are catalog additions without rewriting existing history rows; acquisition is bounded by 1s lock_timeout and each statement by 5s statement_timeout.
add-constraint: The country CHECK is NOT VALID, so adding it enforces new writes without scanning old history; the registered online phase validates old rows after release of the schema lock.
create-table-references: The new empty country-clear table adds foreign keys to existing organization, user, and owner rows without scanning a populated child table; referenced-table lock acquisition is bounded by 1s and the statement by 5s.
row-level-security: ENABLE and FORCE RLS affect only the newly created empty country-clear table and are catalog changes under 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
create-policy: The tenant and owner policies are installed only on the new empty country-clear table; each catalog statement has 1s lock_timeout and 5s statement_timeout.
create-trigger: Installing the two stale-import fence triggers on existing history entries is catalog-only without a row scan; the writer-blocking lock has 1s acquisition and 5s statement bounds.
